name: Client onboarding
goal: Get a new client's ID and checks done in one go, so they can start in days, not weeks.

assistant.greeting: Hi, I can help you bring on a new client. Ask me about ID, the checks or what each document needs to show.

answers.reply: We need one photo ID for each person: a current passport or Australian driver licence. The name and date of birth must match the client details.
Proof of address can be a utility bill, bank statement or rates notice, dated in the last 3 months, in the client's name.
For a company or trust, we need ID for anyone who owns or controls 25% or more. The company extract shows us who they are.
If anyone involved holds, or has held, a senior government role, the client needs extra checks and a senior sign-off. It doesn't stop them becoming a client.
If the documents are right first time, the checks take minutes and approval usually happens the same day.

assistant.fallback: In the real app I'd answer that from our onboarding policy. For now, try asking about ID, proof of address, owners or government roles.

steps.label: Client details
steps.goal: Tell us who the client is, so we know which ID and checks they need.

fields.label: Client name
fields.hint: The legal name of the person or organisation

fields.label: Does anyone involved hold a senior government role?
fields.hint: Now or in the past, here or overseas

steps.label: ID and documents
steps.goal: Add the client's ID and documents. Each one is checked as you add it, so we don't have to chase them later.

checklist.name: Photo ID
checklist.check: Current passport or driver licence for each director and owner
checklist.sample: The driver licence for one director expired in August

checklist.name: Proof of address
checklist.check: In the client's name, dated in the last 3 months
checklist.sample: The electricity bill is dated May, more than 3 months ago

checklist.name: Company extract
checklist.check: Current, showing every director and shareholder
checklist.sample: The extract is from 2024 and shows a director who has since left

checklist.name: Signed engagement letter
checklist.check: Signed by someone the company extract says can sign
checklist.sample: It's signed by the office manager, who isn't a director

steps.label: Checks
steps.goal: Here's what the ID, sanctions and ownership checks found, and anything that needs a person to look at it.

steps.label: Approve
steps.goal: Compliance sees the client with every check done, and approves them to start.

config.confirmText: The client partner will go back to the client with your note. Say which documents or details are still needed.
